recommendation: Keep this source fix as-is. It completes the published non-substantive clarification without changing cardinality, type, or conformance behavior; FHIR-12454 remains a separate no-change background decision and needs no new commit.
issue_request: FHIR-14026 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 by Patient Administration. It requested clearer Patient.photo guidance that photos are identification photos rather than clinical photos, should be thumbnail-sized, and should keep byte count low; the resolution also explicitly named Person.photo and Practitioner.photo.
initial_application: The Jira-tagged commit 6aa19bcefb added the requested guidance to the old Patient spreadsheet, and the 2021 source refactor preserved that guidance on source/patient/structuredefinition-Patient.xml. The same guidance was not present on the current active Person.photo or Practitioner.photo StructureDefinition source before this reconciliation.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini has active entries for Patient, Person, and Practitioner, and these StructureDefinition XML files are current resource sources. The older FHIR-12454 no-change decision supports retaining photos as lightweight identification thumbnails rather than clinical Media resources. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision or community discussion.
reconciliation: Added the same Guidelines comment already present on Patient.photo to Person.photo and Practitioner.photo so all resources named by the published Jira resolution carry the identification-photo, thumbnail-size, and low-byte-count guidance.
